description: 4 exemplars (1 de) + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Exemplars are the present-focused snapshot request in the phrasings the skill's description and When-to-use name: 'create context', 'document this area', orientation before a multi-area feature. Near-misses share the 'document' / 'context' vocabulary and belong elsewhere: a forward-looking roadmap (roadmap-management, named in this skill's Do-NOT list), the fixed knowledge-layer templates (context-authoring), and finding docs that already exist (project-docs). Counterexamples guard the 'context' homonym and plain feature work, which the skill excludes.

queries.q: create context for the billing module so the next agent can orient itself
document this area — key files, tables, endpoints and known issues of the import pipeline
I'm about to touch notifications, payments and the queue — write a structured snapshot of how those areas work today first
erstell mir ein Context-Dokument für das Auth-Modul, damit ich mich da einarbeiten kann
write a roadmap for migrating the billing module to the new payment provider
queries.note: same area, but future- and task-focused rather than a present-state snapshot → roadmap-management, which this skill's Do-NOT list names

queries.q: fill in the tenant-boundaries and data-sensitivity context files for this project
queries.note: shares the 'context file' vocabulary, but these are the fixed knowledge-layer templates with an interactive walkthrough → context-authoring

queries.q: is there already a doc somewhere that explains the import pipeline?
queries.note: looking up existing documentation, not writing a new snapshot → project-docs

queries.q: my context window is almost full — summarize this chat for a fresh session
queries.note: the 'context' homonym — conversation context, not a codebase-area document

queries.q: add a CSV export button to the invoices page
queries.note: plain feature work, which the skill explicitly excludes
